text: A topological space X is Hausdorff (T₂) iff:
choices: every sequence has at most one limit
any two distinct points have disjoint neighbourhoods
every continuous function on X is bounded
explanation: T₂ (Hausdorff): for x≠y, there exist open U∋x and V∋y with U∩V=∅. Hausdorff spaces have unique limits for convergent sequences/filters.
